paragraphs: During the morning peak, open barriers and route traffic to prevent entrance congestion. At quieter times, collect cards, issue receipts, and indicate open spaces, clearing a path before large vehicles enter narrow areas. During valet service, reverse vehicles steadily into spaces and record keys carefully. During the evening peak, clear outbound traffic and patrol for blocked lanes or leaks, then reconcile accounts and clean the booth before leaving.
